name: rapid_holdings_stress
description: Stress-tests the holdings-correction path (src/agent_loop.py's holdings-claim verification, and its interaction with the ticker LoRA's dedup-buffer fix, 16422cca) more aggressively than the default scenario: back-to-back real DK holdings with no plain, non-holding ticker between them, to check the fix holds up under repeated, consecutive triggering rather than a single occurrence per conversation. All turns use real, in-training tickers DK actually holds, so expect_tool_call: true is asserted throughout except the genuine follow-up. Ticker turns also assert expect_tool: lookup_ticker specifically (real, added 2026-08-28) -- not just that some tool was called, but that it was the correct one, since ask_user or another tool being called instead would otherwise pass the looser expect_tool_call check.

turns.note: real DK holding, immediately after another holdings-correction trigger
same holding asked again, later in the same conversation
a real, short follow-up mixing an earlier holding by name -- should be answerable from context
final repeat -- third real DK holding reference in one conversation
